y-m-06-05.title: Mudzidzi shoma zvakanyanya anogona kuva nemuhwina ndeupi?
y-m-06-05.topic: Kuverenga data: hukama pakati pechasarudzwa zvakanyanya nehuwandu hwose hwevanhu
y-m-06-05.goal: Edza chirevo chokuti "muhwina ane hafu kana kupfuura yehuwandu hwose" nekugadzira mienzaniso inopikisa, uye ushande kuti muhwina anofanira kuva nevadzidzi vangani pashoma kuti pave nemuhwina mumwe chete.
y-m-06-05.material:
Vadzidzi 20 mumwe nomumwe akasarudza menyu imwe yemasikati echikoro kubva ku tteokbokki, gimbap, ramyeon, ne dumplings. Munhu wega wega akasarudza imwe chete. Kana pane menyu imwe chete yakasarudzwa zvakanyanya, tinodaidza menyu iyoyo kuti "muhwina." Kana nhamba imwe chete ndiyo yakawanda zvakanyanya, tinoti hapana muhwina.
Jaei akati, "Menyu inohwina inofanira kusarudzwa nevadzidzi 10 kana kupfuura. Ihafu ye 20."

y-m-06-05.thinking.2: Kutsvaga nyaya diki zvakanyanya uye kutaura muganho

y-m-06-05.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakanaka yekuziva kana chirevo chaJaei chichigara chakarurama ndeipi?

y-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza huwandu humwe hwemavhoti emuhwina unonaka kuedza kutanga.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.a: Gadzira tafura imwe zvakare apo muhwina ane vadzidzi 10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.a: Nyaya ye 10 yatowirirana nechirevo. Kuti uwane kana pane tafura inopokana nechirevo, unofanira kutsvaga imwe nyaya.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.b: Gadzira tafura apo menyu ina dzese dzine huwandu hwakafanana.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.b: Kana dzese dzakafanana, hapana muhwina, saka haugoni kuedza chirevo.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.c: Fungidzira kuti Jaei akarurama uye utsvage chikonzero.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.c: Kana ukatanga kubva papfungwa yokuti yakarurama uye ukatsvaga zvikonzero chete, unogona kushaya nyaya apo chirevo chinoputsika.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.d: Gadzira tafura apo muhwina ane vadzidzi vashoma pa 10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.d: Kufunga uku kunoedza kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa chirevo iwe pachako.

y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Menyu ina dzinofanira kuwedzera kusvika pavadzidzi 20.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Tteokbokki ine vakawanda kupfuura dzimwe menyu dzese, saka ndiyo muhwina.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Tteokbokki inofanira kuva nevakawanda kupfuura gimbap, ramyeon, nedumplings imwe neimwe.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Muhwina ane vadzidzi 9 kana vashoma, saka inopikisa chirevo chaJaei.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Kana muhwina ane vadzidzi 10 kana kupfuura, ndiyo nyaya inowirirana nechirevo chaJaei. Edza vadzidzi 9 kana vashoma.

y-m-06-05.s.s3.prompt: Kana vadzidzi 20 mumwe nomumwe akasarudza imwe yemenyu ina uye pane muhwina mumwe chete, huwandu hushoma zvakanyanya hwevadzidzi vangaita vakasarudza menyu inohwina ndehupi?
y-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.0: Seta muhwina pavadzidzi 5, uye unyore huwandu hukuru hunogona kuva nemamwe menyu matatu pamwe chete kana dzese dziri pasi pe 5.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.a: Kana ukapatsanura vadzidzi 20 zvakaenzana pakati pemenyu ina, ndi 5 imwe neimwe. Asi kana dzese dzakafanana, hapana muhwina mumwe chete.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.b: Kana muhwina ane 5, vamwe vese vari 4 kana vashoma, saka hazvikwani. Zvinoita kubva pavadzidzi 6.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.c: Ichokwadi kuti tafura ine 7 iripo, asi tarisa kana nhamba diki inogonekawo.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.d: Vadzidzi 10 ndiko kukosha kwakataurwa naJaei. Tangogadzira tafura ine vashoma.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.explain: Kana muhwina ane 5, menyu mbiri dzimwe nhatu imwe neimwe ine 4 kana vashoma, saka 5+4+4+4=17 haisvike 20. Ne 6, unogona kugadzira 6+5+5+4=20. Saka muhwina ane 6 kana kupfuura.

y-m-06-08.title: Kuenzanisa Ma Picture Graph Emakirasi Matatu
y-m-06-08.topic: Ma picture graph: kana nhamba iyo mufananidzo mumwe unomirira ichisiyana kubva pagraph kuenda kune imwe
y-m-06-08.goal: Dzidza kuti nhamba iyo mufananidzo mumwe unomirira inogona kusiyana kubva pagraph kuenda kune imwe, simbisa kuti haugoni kutonga zvakawanda kana zvishoma kubva kuhuwandu hwemifananidzo chete, gadzira muenzaniso apo huwandu hwemifananidzo nehwemabhuku hausangani, uye utaure kubvumirana kunoita kuti graph iverengwe nyore.
y-m-06-08.material:
Mabhuku akaverengwa nemakirasi matatu muna Kubvumbi muraibhurari yechikoro anoratidzwa mu picture graph yekirasi imwe neimwe. Huwandu hwemabhuku ayo mufananidzo mumwe (◎) unomirira hwakasiyana pagraph imwe neimwe. Mu Class 1 ne Class 3, ◎ imwe ndimabhuku 10, uye mu Class 2, ◎ imwe ndimabhuku 5.
Class 1: ◎ 4
Class 2: ◎ 7
Class 3: ◎ 5
Seoyun akati, 'Kirasi ine mifananidzo yakawanda yakaverenga mabhuku akawanda zvakanyanya.'
